generation_rationale: Six direct public-only reconstruction hypotheses and the seeded analog Stage-B challenger failed. This generation preserves the strongest sealed Stage-A prediction and tests whether its error is predictably transferable from strictly earlier outer blocks. It does not tune an existing blend, threshold, alpha, or gate on exposed outer scores.

prequential_protocol.fraction_isolation: Each fraction trains only from earlier-fold residuals produced by the Stage-A OOF file at that same fraction.

common_features.grain: one timestamp profile with ordered target layers 2,3,4
common_features.incomplete_registered_profile_policy: Only complete 2/3/4 profiles enter residual fitting; every registered row at an incomplete current profile remains the exact Stage-A no-op.
common_features.scaling: training-fold median and IQR/1.349, standard-deviation then one fallback, non-finite to training median, clip [-12,12]
common_features.postprocess: pinned public layer-1/layer-5 endpoint isotonic projection followed by CSV float roundtrip

hypotheses.description: Fit a rank-2 SVD basis to earlier-fold three-layer Stage-A residual profiles, then map public state and the Stage-A profile to the two residual scores with one fixed multi-output ridge solve.
Fit one fixed Huber linear residual model per target layer on strictly earlier folds, retaining direct robust corrections rather than a shared profile basis.
hypotheses.model: sklearn HuberRegressor epsilon=1.35, alpha=1.0, max_iter=200, fit_intercept=true

hypotheses.description: Fit a fixed multi-output extremely randomized forest to earlier-fold residual profiles. This tests nonlinear transferable correction while leaving the Stage-A prediction as the identity base.
hypotheses.model: sklearn ExtraTreesRegressor n_estimators=256, max_depth=12, min_samples_leaf=32, max_features=0.75, bootstrap=false, n_jobs=8
hypotheses.seed_aggregation: prediction mean before postprocess and metric

lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_safe_residual_gate: No alpha is fit between two frozen candidate surfaces and no exposed block-consistency derivative is used; each hypothesis learns a new correction function only from chronologically prior residual labels.
lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_nasa_power_residual_meta: No external meteorology, pooled leave-one-block-out alpha grid, or control-versus-candidate feature comparison is used.
lineage_disclosure.distinct_from_stage_b_analog: Stage-A remains the identity base and residual labels, not target profiles, are transferred strictly forward across outer blocks.
